role: Public products, working builds, proof surfaces, and routing limits for the SCBE-AETHERMOORE assistant.

public_products.name: AI Governance Toolkit
public_products.description: Templates, thresholds, decision records, and starter rollout guidance for governed AI work.

public_products.name: HYDRA Agent Templates
public_products.description: Ready-made agent roles, packet patterns, and launch structure for small governed swarms.

public_products.name: n8n Workflow Pack
public_products.description: Governed automation building blocks for teams that need importable workflows and a cleaner delivery path.

public_products.name: Content Spin Engine
public_products.description: Source-once content operations for adapting, reviewing, and publishing across channels with less drift.

public_products.name: Operator Agent Bus
public_products.description: Dated public evidence surface for the Operator Agent Bus, constrained-decoding gate checks, and receipt-backed training artifacts.

public_products.name: AetherBrowser
public_products.description: A governed desktop browser with an agent sidepanel, bounded actions, page analysis, and a local control plane. The public page is a simulation; desktop source is public.

public_products.name: AetherDesk
public_products.description: A local-first desktop for bounded AI and human workflows, with registered actions and receipts instead of unrestricted host control.

public_products.name: SCBE SDK
public_products.description: The public TypeScript and Python package surface for governed automation and risk-scoring experiments.

public_products.name: Trust Verifier
public_products.description: A local Python and JavaScript cross-checker that reports disagreements with concrete witnesses. Agreement is evidence, not a proof of correctness.

public_products.name: Buyer Delivery Guide
public_products.description: Public description of paid-packet delivery, buyer-only download URLs, support recovery, and separation from open-source code.

public_products.name: Operations Evidence
public_products.description: July 25, 2026 operations snapshot covering competition planning, experiments, package inventory, and scoped capability records. Treat expired rows as historical.

public_products.name: AI Red Team as a Service
public_products.description: A scoped adversarial evaluation that starts from a project-authored regression corpus, adds system-specific tests, and reports observed findings and limitations.

public_products.name: CX Refund Guardrail
public_products.description: A scoped middleware pilot intended to catch unsupported refund promises. Compatibility, latency, and acceptance thresholds are tested per implementation.

public_products.name: ISO 42001 Evidence Service
public_products.description: Project-authored testing and evidence packaging mapped to selected governance controls. It supports audit preparation but is not certification or legal advice.

custom_buckets.name: Assistant and site setup
custom_buckets.description: Turn a static site into a route-aware assistant surface with tool lanes, manuals, support, and a clear front door.

custom_buckets.name: Workflow packaging
custom_buckets.description: Package public workflow logic into a buyer-readable manual, delivery path, and operational setup that fits your site.

custom_buckets.name: Content operations surface
custom_buckets.description: Build a public content system with article, research, support, and assistant surfaces that stay in sync.

restricted_buckets.name: Government or high-assurance work
restricted_buckets.description: Government, DARPA, proprietary, or high-assurance engagements are not sold through the public assistant and require gated handling.
restricted_buckets.boundary: The public assistant can acknowledge the lane and route to intake, but it should not expose protected workflows or internal details.
